name: Compiled program F
arch:
A 1-layer transformer with no LayerNorm. Vocabulary of 6 tokens; the input is a sequence of 6 tokens; residual stream width 18.
  x = W_E[tokens] + W_pos
  layer 0: attention (1 head of size 7, bidirectional, biases b_Q, b_K, b_V, b_O): x = x + softmax((x W_Q + b_Q)(x W_K + b_K)^T / sqrt(7)) (x W_V + b_V) W_O + b_O;  then MLP (16 ReLU neurons): x = x + relu(x W_in + b_in) W_out + b_out
  output = x[positions 1..5] @ W_U: 2 numbers for each of the last 5 positions, flattened as (position - 1) * 2 + class. The network's decision at a position is its largest of those 2 numbers.
context: Token 0 is a begin-of-sequence marker and always comes first; tokens [1, 2, 3, 5] stand for ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd']. Output class c at a position stands for the value ['0', '1'][c].

answer.short: output i is 1 if token i equals the first token, else 0
answer.detail: Custom RASP program: attention copies the first token to every position; an MLP compares the copied token with the position's own token. Compiled by Tracr; residual labels before rotation: ['first_10:a', 'first_10:b', 'first_10:c', 'first_10:d', 'indices:0', 'indices:1', 'indices:2', 'indices:3', 'indices:4', 'one', 'same_as_first_9:0', 'same_as_first_9:1', 'tokens:BOS', 'tokens:a', 'tokens:b', 'tokens:c', 'tokens:compiler_pad', 'tokens:d'].

source: Compiled with Tracr (Lindner et al. 2023) in lab/targets/build_tracr.py; residual stream rotated, MLP neurons permuted and rescaled.

domain.text: The network is used on every input [0, t1, ..., t5] where each of t1..t5 is one of the tokens [1, 2, 3, 5] (1,024 inputs).
